# Imperium Solutions

> Imperium Solutions Inc. provides managed customer support, virtual assistance, and back office operations for US and international businesses. Teams work from home on the client's hours. Imperium recruits, trains, schedules, supervises, and reports on the team, and the client sets the responsibilities, coverage hours, and service standards.

Imperium is a Top Rated agency on Upwork (100% Job Success across 27 jobs, more than 4,900 hours delivered, on Upwork since 2020, team size 11 to 50 people). Every figure can be checked on the public Upwork profile: https://www.upwork.com/agencies/1296021528865828864/

## Services

- Customer support (front office): live chat, email, and voice support, customer inquiries, onboarding and account assistance, ticket management, follow ups, and escalations. Coverage can be business hours, extended hours, or round the clock.
- Virtual assistance and administration (back office): CRM management and data organization, inbox, calendar, and appointment coordination, sales administration and lead follow ups, executive assistance.
- Project management and operations (back office): project tracking and team coordination, digital operations and workflow management, process documentation and reporting.

## Industries

Imperium accepts every industry. Delivered work: real estate (UK brokerage), crypto and fintech (900+ hours of round the clock live chat), education (835 hours of project management and digital operations), software and SaaS (customer success for an AI software company). Supported: healthcare, property management, ecommerce. Compliance requirements, where they apply, are scoped with the client before launch.

## How it works

Every engagement follows the same 90 day plan. Days 1 to 30, launch: define requirements, coordinate staffing, train the team, go live, establish KPIs. Days 31 to 60, stabilize: monitor quality, coach the team, improve workflows. Days 61 to 90, review: review performance with the client and recommend adjustments or expansion. The client provides a point of contact, requirements, coverage hours, system access, available documentation, and approval of service standards. Imperium manages recruitment coordination, onboarding and training, workflows and KPIs, scheduling and supervision, quality assurance, coaching, escalations, and weekly and monthly reporting. Timelines depend on project scope and staffing requirements.
